content.body:
Up-gunned and up-armored, this revision to the now-venerable Panzer III series granted it new life. The armor upgrades make some of the front and rear armor effective against the common British 2 Pounder AT gun. The Kwk 50 L42 50 mm gun boasted a big increase in hitting power over the earlier 37 mm gun but still struggled against the heavier British and French tanks of the period. It achieved fame in the desert battles of North Africa, as the Panzer III H could finally fight toe-to-toe against British medium tanks. By mid war, this tank was made instantly obsolete by the suprise of the Russian T34. The Panzer III H could not survive trading shots with the T34, and it could not be up-gunned.
Recognizable by its extended turret bustle, the Panzer III H is seductive. As the first well-armored German turreted tank in the field, it’s possible to be lulled into a false sense of security by the AP rounds bouncing off your now thicker mantlet. The 50 mm gun is much more lethal. Combined with the characteristically superior German sights this means that the Panzer III H is extremely effective, especially compared with its ancestors. Despite this, the 50 mm gun remains unable to penetrate the fronts of the Char B1 bis and the Matilda, and the thicker armor is only on the front hull/turret and the rear hull; your flanks are still vulnerable particularly to side turret hits.
This tank is quite good at overwatch duty for smaller, less capable tanks. Be their "big brother" and lend extra effectiveness to them with your greater combat ability. Alternatively, sit at the rear of a wedge or reversed-wedge formation in company with heavier tanks like StuG's and Panzer IV G's, and screen the flanks of your formation while the "heavies" engage in the front. Continue to play the tank carefully, recognizing the particular danger of flank or rear shots. Your commander is only useful if he is able to see so leave him unbuttoned most of the time (pull him in during air attack or if you are entering an urban area). If he is killed, the slight risk to your tank through his open hatch) will have been more than offset by his utility to that point if you used him to spot for you.
Move quickly from cover to cover, use shadows and brush to break up your outline as much as possible.
CONTROLS & VARIATIONS:
Gunner sight now has a fully-modeled multi-ammo sight; PzGr is the range for AP rounds, SprGr is the range setting for HE.
Driver (position 1) starts with the vision slit open. Press O to drop the shield. With the vision shield in place, the telescopic periscope works (press Numpad . to cycle through zoom levels).
As the Commander (position 2), press 0 to unbutton/button. Press Numpad . to cycle through binoculars.
As the Gunner (position 3) press Numpad . to cycle through zoom levels. Use Page Up and Page Down to adjust the range setting of the gun sights. Gunner can also open a vision port on the turret by pressing O and then Numpad 0 to see through it.
As the Hull Gunner (position 4) press Numpad . to cycle through zoom levels.
